Grayscale Investments has launched the Grayscale Dogecoin Trust, offering institutional and accredited investors exposure to Dogecoin. $DOGE

Dogecoin, initially created as a meme coin, has evolved into a widely adopted digital asset with a market capitalization of $50 billion. https://t.co/lzenaaUdU0

Many crypto investors believe that the Securities and Exchange Commission will approve a spot DOGE ETF later this year. 

According to Polymarket, the odds of a spot Dogecoin ETF rose to 62% on Thursday from a low of 27% in January. https://t.co/wTXbKhMuuW
